detail:
Emphatic progressive: really doing it right now.

> Example: Sedang mandinya = He's really bathing right now

Conditional: "if".

> Example: Kalau hujan, saya di rumah

Purpose: "so that / in order that".

> Example: Belajar supaya lulus

Obligation: "must". Stronger than sebaiknya.

> Example: Harus pergi = must go

Experience: "ever (done)".

> Example: Sudah pernah ke Bali? = Have you ever been to Bali?
